title: 3.4 Auto Mode and Prediction
concept: Automatic AVL rebalancing and rotation prediction
objective: Predict the rotation pivot (or attachment parent if balanced) by clicking that node before each insert!
controls: Click predicted pivot/parent node to trigger next AVL insert
start_status: Click the rotation pivot node on the AVL tree to insert!
hints: Walk the incoming key down from the root. The pivot is the lowest node that becomes unbalanced - or the parent it attaches to if nothing breaks.
